description: Human approval, safety, and redaction policy. The tool never publishes, deletes, trains, or calls external services by itself.
prohibited: embedded credentials or paid service tokens in briefs, config, or artifacts
arbitrary shell commands or arbitrary network calls from a plan
publishing, deletion, or training without a recorded approval
claiming pixel-level QA results without rendered media

approval_workflow.scope: token is scoped to one capability and expires

human_review_note: Human approval remains available for identity, rights, safety, factual, medical, political, and high-impact use cases.

external_integrations.note: Provider adapters, encoders, storage systems, and model endpoints are configurable and disabled by default.
